_about: Our fixes of SC's Pali root text (root/pli/ms), from compare/sc-report/1-errors-in-sc-ms.md: places where SC differs from the printed Mahāsaṅgīti it was made from and every other edition agrees with the print. apply.py writes them into the SC checkout until SC fixes them upstream; a segment that no longer holds `old` is left alone and reported.
